wildhunt.skill.storm_crown.description: Piercing railbolts chain to nearby foes. Thunderstorm sustains a lightning field. Storm Mantle boosts movement, attack speed and lightning power. Wet targets take 30% extra damage. Damage grows with EP and mastery. Evolve as Sovereign Hunter after mastery.
wildhunt.skill.raijin.description: Piercing railbolts chain to nearby foes. Thunderstorm sustains a lightning field. Storm Mantle boosts movement, attack speed and lightning power. Wet targets take 30% extra damage. Ultimate: triple base damage, greater defenses and a ten-second domain.
